links.seed_title: Bar Magnet With Iron Filings in 3D
links.seed_text: Bar Magnet With Iron Filings in 3D: A central bar magnet with visible north/south pole caps emits curved, glowing field line tubes through a cloud of small metallic particles that align, rotate, and clump along the lines, with labels and faint trails showing how particles move when the magnet is rotated.
